Only in The Shema and the instruction to teach: When your son asks what the laws mean, recite the exodus story; Swear only by God's name; Teach the words to your children when sitting, walking, lying down and rising; Words bound as a sign on the hand and between the eyes (phylacteries); Do not put God to the test as at Massah; When you eat and are full, beware lest you forget God; Words written on doorposts and gates (mezuzah); Israel will inherit cities, houses, cisterns, vineyards and olives they did not build or plant; Love God with all your heart, soul and might; Those who remember God standing, sitting and on their sides and reflect on creation; Promised land described as flowing with milk and honey.

Only in Sincerity, daybreak and mankind: God's unity and the two refuges: Refuge from the evil of darkness (or the moon) when it settles (ghasiq idha waqab); Refuge from the evil of an envier when he envies (evil eye); God is al-Samad (the Eternal Refuge, the solid one who needs nothing); Triple title: Lord of mankind, King of mankind, God of mankind; Refuge from the evil of the slinking whisperer (al-waswas al-khannas) who whispers in people's breasts, from jinn and humans; God does not beget and was not begotten; God does not beget and was not begotten [contrast between the texts]; Protection from the terror of the night, the arrow by day, the pestilence (dever) stalking in darkness and Qeteb that ravages at noon; Protective formula 'Say: I seek refuge with the Lord of...' (qul a'udhu bi-rabbi) against named evils; Refuge from the evil of those (women) who blow on knots (al-naffathat fi al-'uqad), i.e. knot-tying sorcery; Psalm used as protection against demons and harm (later amulet and 'song of plagues'); Cluster of divine epithets in sequence (e.g. the Forgiving, the Loving, Lord of the Throne, the Glorious, doer of what he wills; or Lord, King, God of mankind); and 2 more.

matches.note: lam yalid wa-lam yūlad ~ beni ʾattāh ʾănî ha-yyôm yelidtîkā: the same root (w-l-d / y-l-d) affirmed of God toward the king in the Psalm, denied of God absolutely in the Quran.
